brief: Watches a folder in a worker thread of the engine and hands back the files added, modified or deleted since the last look.
detail: Watch starts the worker, which polls the folder about every 250 ms. Drain, called on your own schedule, returns the queued events as [ kind, name ] pairs, kind being ADD, MOD or DEL, and empties the queue. Stop ends the worker. Events carry the file name inside the folder, not a full path.
